''See also: [[Empty Palm Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The [[Empty]] Palm is a specialized combat [[technique]] characterized by the projection of neutral or [[pure madra]] through a palm thrust. Originally developed by an individual with limited talent as an underhanded method to compensate for their lack of natural ability, the [[technique]] functions by injecting energy directly into an opponent's core. When used against a human being, the strike disrupts their [[spirit]] and washes their [[madra channels]] clean, temporarily stripping them of control over their own power and leaving them physically incapacitated. When applied to a [[spirit]], the [[technique]] is even more destructive, capable of blasting away the very substance of their physical form. While primarily used as a means to disable an enemy's core, the [[technique]] has been adapted and expanded through various applications. It can be utilized as a [[Striker]] move, integrated with [[Forging]] to create massive, oversized handprints of energy, or combined with [[soulfire]] to increase its lethality. Practitioners have also experimented with executing the move through other means, such as kicks, or using it to interact with magical [[scripts]]. Despite its effectiveness, the [[technique]] requires precise [[madra]] control to ensure the correct amount of energy is injected upon contact. It remains a central component of certain combat paths, serving as a primary method for overcoming opponents who might otherwise be too powerful to face through conventional means.}}

== Unsouled ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|The [[Empty]] Palm is a combat [[technique]] utilized by [[Lindon]] that involves concentrating [[madra]] at the base of his hand to produce an invisible, thorn-like effect. When deployed, the strike drives into an opponent like a hammer hitting a nail, reaching only a few inches to inject force directly into the enemy's core. This method serves to disrupt the [[spirit]] of a target and is powerful enough for a [[sacred artist]] to affect an opponent on their own level. [[Lindon]] found the [[technique]] perfectly suited to his needs and employed it during his various fights, including a successful strike against [[Li Markuth|Markuth]]'s core.}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|The [[Empty]] Palm is a specialized [[technique]] designed to slam directly into a target's core. To utilize [[Hollow King]] [[madra]], the method would require complete reinvention. During his journey, [[Lindon]] employed the [[technique]] to blast a chunk out of the storm gecko known as [[Remnant]] and later used it against [[Seishen Daji|Daji]]. He eventually utilized the [[Empty]] Palm to successfully strike the core of an enemy [[Underlord]].}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|The [[Empty]] Palm [[technique]] was first utilized by [[Little Blue]] before being employed by [[Lindon]] against a swarm of silver bats. This ability functions by washing a human's [[madra channels]] clean and stripping them of control over their [[spirit]], while it blasts away the material of a [[spirit]]'s body. [[Lindon]] later applied the [[technique]] to meet acidic liquid and successfully executed a version infused with [[soulfire]].}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|As [[Lindon]]'s oldest and first [[technique]], the [[Empty]] Palm is a skill he has worked to perfect more than any other. This ability has been used to disarm an [[Archlord]]’s [[puppet construct]] and dissolve incoming arrows. During combat, [[Little Blue]] utilized an [[Empty]] Palm scaled to the size of her human body to eliminate [[Striker techniques]]. [[Lindon]] also demonstrated the [[technique]] by projecting a blue-white handprint, and at its most powerful, an [[Empty]] Palm can warp regional [[aura]] and cover the entire sky.}}
